FullRegression.Title: Three visible clan cards and all trait-icon hovers
FullRegression.CoverageRule: Every trait that appears on the three visible clan cards is in scope, regardless of the IsPersonality flag. Record the trait ID before marking its tooltip Verified.

DynamicTraitDiscovery.Scope: All trait icons visible on all three clan cards, including non-personality traits
DynamicTraitDiscovery.CoordinateRule: All trait coordinates use the 2560x1440 game-client reference space and are scaled to the live client before moving the cursor. Each card has an upper icon at y=610 and a lower icon at y=639. The three cards use x=1182, 1331, and 1483. These coordinates target icon slots only; the trait ID remains random and must be identified from a visible trait tooltip before persistence.

FullRegression.Setup: Load BVT-LCL from the main menu and open the top-left clan screen.

RandomDiscoveryLastRun.Note: The random layout did not expose a confirmed non-personality trait. Fixed-save coordinates hit a clan detail card on one point and were not reused or counted as random coverage.

Evidence.Note: The 2026-07-23 fixed-save calibration proved the stable six icon slots: (1182,610), (1182,639), (1331,610), (1331,639), (1483,610), and (1483,639). The previous y=608 and y=666 points hit portrait/detail UI or fell below the trait icon and are invalid. Random clan cards may show any of the 92 personality or 14 non-personality traits; every visible trait must be recorded by ID, hovered, and verified. Non-personality traits are in scope and are never skipped because IsPersonality is false.
